email.body1:
Monica, saw CADDi raise the $38M Atomico round, ship CADDi Quote, and double down on US expansion.

Scaling into the US that fast usually means more manufacturers in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CADDi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Monica, quick follow-up for CADDi.

Post-raise, pipeline expectations on the US push usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CADDi needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Monica, last bit of proof for CADDi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CADDi's reply rate likely compares to other expansion-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to CADDi either way.
